compos.text: Alt text: A smartphone UI element displaying a vision test result. The text reads, "Your result is 20/15! Congratulations! Your acuity in the right eye is superb! You have better-than-normal vision!" Below the text, there are three buttons: a blue button with a Facebook icon labeled "Share," a black button with a Google Play icon labeled "Rate app," and a red button labeled "Back to Main."
"Congratulations! Your acuity in the right eye is superb! You have better-than-normal vision!"
"Facebook Share button with the Facebook logo and the text 'Share'."
A red button with white text that reads "Back to Main."

The image shows a smartphone status bar with the following icons from left to right:

1. Facebook icon (repeated four times)
2. Clock icon
3. Lock icon
4. Android icon
5. Bluetooth icon
6. Wi-Fi icon
7. Signal strength icon
8. Battery icon
9. Time displayed as "12:21"
"Rate app" button with a Google Play Store icon.

"Your result is 20/15!" displayed on a blue background.

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen displays the results of a visual acuity test. The main content includes:

1. **Result Display**: The user's visual acuity result is shown as "20/15," indicating better-than-normal vision.
2. **Congratulatory Message**: A message congratulates the user on their superb right eye acuity.
3. **Share Option**: A button to share the result on Facebook.
4. **Rate App Option**: A button to rate the app on the Google Play Store.
5. **Navigation**: A button to go back to the main screen of the app.

The screen is designed to provide feedback on the user's visual acuity and offers options for sharing the result and rating the app.
